guide.summary: Neruda's house, art, natural-history and maritime museums, a former-prison cultural park and an immigrant museum, with breakfast cafés, seafood lunches, dinners, bars and bakeries checked against their own websites.
highlights: Museo de Bellas Artes Palacio Baburizza
guide.tip: Plan museum days with care: La Sebastiana, the Palacio Baburizza and the Parque Cultural open Tuesday to Sunday, the Museo de Historia Natural is closed on Sundays and Mondays, and the Museo Marítimo Nacional lists daily hours.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: La Sebastiana, the Palacio Baburizza and the Parque Cultural open Tuesday to Sunday, while the Museo de Historia Natural is closed on Sundays, Mondays and holidays. The Museo Marítimo Nacional lists daily hours of 10:00 to 18:00, closing only on 1 January, 1 May and 25 December.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Museo de Historia Natural is free for everyone, and the Palacio Baburizza charges foreign visitors $6.000 with under-12s free. La Sebastiana's 2026 general ticket is $11.000, and the Museo del Inmigrante sells foreign-visitor tickets at $18.000 online, with children under 6 free alongside an adult.

toolkit.label: Walk-in or book
toolkit.copy: La Sebastiana takes no reservations and admits visitors in order of arrival. Casalegre books tables by WhatsApp with day, time and party size, and Restaurante Caleta Portales takes reservations only by phone or WhatsApp.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Pets are not permitted at La Sebastiana, and the Museo Marítimo Nacional admits visitors until 30 minutes before closing. MarAlegre's booking page asks for a credit card, charges UF 0.5 per person for cancellations inside 24 hours and holds tables for 30 minutes.

guide.dek: Put the museums between Tuesday and Saturday, and book hill-top dinners in Cerro Alegre and Cerro Concepción ahead.
intro: Start with La Sebastiana, Pablo Neruda's house at Ricardo de Ferrari 692 on Cerro Bellavista. The Fundación Neruda's notice of 2 November 2026 gives Tuesday-to-Sunday opening from 10:00 to 18:00. Entry is walk-in only, in order of arrival, with a 2026 general ticket of $11.000 and audio guides in six languages. Down on Cerro Alegre, the Palacio Baburizza at Paseo Yugoslavo 176 opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 18:00. Until 27 December 2026 it shows prize-winning works from the XIII Bienal Internacional de Artes de Valparaíso.

The Museo de Historia Natural at Condell 1546 is free for everyone. It opens Tuesday to Friday from 10:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 11:00 to 16:00, and closes on Sundays, Mondays and holidays. 'Sinapsis', a photographic look at early Chilean neurosurgery, runs from 5 November to 24 December 2026. On Cerro Artillería, the Museo Marítimo Nacional lists daily hours from 10:00 to 18:00 and a 2026 foreign-visitor rate of $4.000. The Parque Cultural, in the former prison at Cumming 580, opens its gates Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 20:00.

On Cerro Concepción, Destino Valparaíso at Concepción 499 houses the Museo del Inmigrante, with tickets sold online at $12.000 general, $18.000 for foreign visitors and free entry for children under 6 with an adult. The same complex lists María María for all-day breakfast and fresh bread, Stefani for Romanian family pastries, and Moritz Eis gelato, open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 19:00. Da Mafalda serves Sardinian pasta and takes reservations by WhatsApp. The Jardín Cervecero advertises Friday and Saturday garden nights at 21:00.

For dinner, Casalegre at Paseo Dimalow 249 pairs seafood plates with Negronis from $5.900 and takes bookings by WhatsApp. MarAlegre at Casa Higueras, Higuera 133, serves a buffet breakfast and à la carte lunch and dinner, and asks for a credit card to hold a table. Restaurant La Concepción at Papudo 541 lists a Monday closure on its website. For seafood by the water, Restaurante Caleta Portales sits a few steps from Estación Portales. Panadería Doña Javiera on Cerro Los Placeres bakes pan batido in a wood-fired oven.
summaryCards: Pair La Sebastiana and the Palacio Baburizza, both open Tuesday to Sunday, with the Museo Marítimo Nacional, which lists daily hours.
Have an all-day breakfast at María María in Destino Valparaíso, then visit the free Museo de Historia Natural, which is closed on Sundays and Mondays.
La Sebastiana takes no reservations, Casalegre books by WhatsApp, and MarAlegre asks for a credit card to hold a table.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several restaurant sites carry no 2026 date (Restaurant La Concepción is undated, Portofino's footer reads 2025, Tres Peces' 2024, MarAlegre's latest content is 2025, TallerCafé is undated), so their hours are attributed to those pages rather than stated as current. Hours were not published for Teatro Municipal, Biblioteca Santiago Severín, the Museo del Inmigrante, MarAlegre, Hotel Brighton, María María, Stefani and the Jardín Cervecero. The Destino Valparaíso tenants are confirmed through the complex's own site, not individual websites. Café Turri (connection reset), MUGO (certificate error), the Congreso Nacional (403 on camara.cl and senado.cl) and several restaurant domains that did not resolve could not be read; these failures are not evidence of closure. No official operator page with current funicular (ascensor) hours or fares was found.
